title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
summaryEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設支撐接觸後的等效剛度k=200 kN/mm，施加力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。保持剛度不變，力增量提高10%至660 kN，縮短為3.3 mm。實際千斤頂行程還包含座板間隙、圍檁、壁體及設備變形，因此不能用這個三毫米推定全部接觸已閉合。驗證應將力與兩端位移同步記錄，先辨識接觸前後剛度變化，再檢查保留預壓、溫度軸力和鄰支撐互制。這些值是原創假設，不是現場施壓指令。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume post-contact support stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, giving elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. With stiffness fixed, a 10% increase to 660 kN gives 3.3 mm. Actual jack stroke also includes seating gaps, waler deformation, wall movement and equipment compliance, so this shortening cannot establish complete contact. Verification records force and both end movements simultaneously, identifies the stiffness change at seating, then checks retained preload, thermal force and interaction with neighbouring struts. These are original assumptions rather than instructions for applying force on site.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」與「支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contact gap mechanism and verification" and "Strut axial stiffness mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接觸間隙」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸間隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers. The target must therefore follow overall excavation deformation and member resistance rather than a desire to maximize initial force. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contact gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接觸間隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contact gap”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。預壓可提早建立傳力路徑，但過高預壓會推動壁體或增加圍檁負擔；目標應由整體開挖變形與構件能力共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. Preload can establish the load path early, but excessive preload pushes the wall or overloads walers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contact gap mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。
支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。
optionsEn: The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed.
Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
quiz.explanation: 支撐初次受力時，部分位移先消耗在座板、接頭及墊塊的接觸間隙，並非全都壓縮鋼構件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial strut movement partly closes gaps at seats, splices and packing rather than compressing the steel alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸間隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact gap” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Contact gap mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 支撐桿件強度足夠，就不用檢查座板下的承壓。
每支支撐都曾達標，就表示整層目前一定同時達標。
原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。
optionsEn: Adequate strut strength eliminates the need to check bearing beneath its seat.
If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously.
Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設接觸後等效剛度k=200 kN/mm、力增量ΔP=600 kN，彈性縮短δ=ΔP/k=3 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For post-contact equivalent stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接觸間隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contact gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓驗收應同時保留力與位移曲線；接觸異常由臨時工程設計者核定修正，不以反覆加壓取代診斷。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preload acceptance retains force and displacement curves; the temporary-works designer approves seating corrections rather than replacing diagnosis with repeated pressurization. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Contact gap mechanism and verification"?
options: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄軸力及兩端相對位移，辨別接觸前的非線性段，再以接觸後斜率比較設計剛度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record force and relative end movement together, identify the nonlinear seating phase, and compare the post-contact slope with design stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接觸間隙的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact gap mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸間隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contact gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸未建立就讀取千斤頂壓力，可能誤判預壓已傳入支撐，卸壓後壁體仍有自由移動空間。線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reading jack pressure before contact is established can falsely indicate transferred preload while the wall retains free movement after unloading. The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線性式適用於接觸後的增量，不包含原始間隙閉合量；實際總行程還含壁體、圍檁與液壓設備的變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The linear expression applies to post-contact increments and excludes initial gap closure; total stroke also includes wall, waler and hydraulic-system deformation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂顯示目標壓力就代表所有接頭間隙已消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The target jack pressure proves every connection gap has closed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Contact gap mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「支撐軸向剛度」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strut axial stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐的軸向剛度由材料模數、截面積及有效長度決定，長支撐即使強度足夠也可能有較大縮短。真實系統還包括接頭及壁體柔度，串聯柔度會降低整體剛度；用單根鋼管剛度代表完整支撐線可能低估開挖位移。此式是均勻線彈性直桿剛度，不是挫屈容量；端部柔度、溫度及受力偏心需以另外的模型處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐軸向剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness. Using the steel member alone to represent the entire support line can therefore underestimate excavation movement and misrepresent load sharing. This is the stiffness of a uniform elastic axial member, not buckling resistance; end flexibility, temperature and eccentricity require separate models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strut axial stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支撐軸向剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Strut axial stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Axial stiffness depends on modulus, area and length, so a long strut can shorten substantially despite adequate strength. The system also includes splice and wall flexibility; serial compliances reduce overall stiffness.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Strut axial stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設E=200 GPa、A=0.02 m²、L=20 m，k=EA/L=200 MN/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 支撐軸向剛度的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐軸向剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 核對截面及長度，以接頭兩側位移和構件應變分離鋼材縮短與接合滑移，再比較等效剛度。分析模型應明列鋼材、接頭、圍檁與壁體柔度；變更接頭型式前由結構設計者重新核對整體剛度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal axial force mechanism and verification" and "Seat bearing mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度附加軸力的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial force mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度附加軸力」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal axial force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐受日照或施工環境變化而伸縮，若兩端受到限制，熱變形會轉成附加軸力。完全拘束給出上限尺度，但壁體與接頭柔度會釋放部分熱應變；監測若未扣除溫度，可能把可逆熱力誤判為土壓需求突然增加。完全拘束式不能直接當場址預測，應用串聯剛度估計釋放程度；日照梯度也會引起彎曲，並非只有均勻軸力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度附加軸力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Struts expand and contract with sunlight and construction conditions, generating axial force when restrained. Full restraint gives a bounding scale, while wall and connection flexibility release part of the thermal strain. Without temperature correction, monitoring may misinterpret reversible thermal force as a sudden increase in earth-pressure demand. The fully restrained expression is not a direct site prediction; serial stiffness determines release, and solar gradients can induce bending as well as uniform axial force. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interaction between struts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步讀取整個支撐層的力與圍檁位移，逐段比較力增量矩陣，核對反力總和及作用位置。預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read the complete support level simultaneously with waler movement, compare incremental interaction patterns, and check reaction sums and positions. The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：預壓及複測順序應由臨時工程設計者指定，驗收採同時力場；不得以逐支歷史最大值取代。兩支力增量相加不代表整體水平平衡，還有其他支撐、土反力及力臂；需納入完整同時自由體圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The temporary-works designer specifies preload and recheck sequence, and acceptance uses a simultaneous force field rather than individual historical maxima. Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同時間的峰值相加會虛構不存在的總支撐力，也可能漏掉某支已卸載而失去接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding peaks from different times invents a total force that never existed and can conceal a strut that has unloaded and lost contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Adding two increments does not establish overall horizontal equilibrium; other struts, soil reactions and lever arms remain, requiring a complete simultaneous free body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If every strut once met its target, the entire level meets all targets simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」與「液壓力校正的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" and "Hydraulic-force calibration mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「第二階偏心」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Second-order eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。此式是已知變形下的附加彎矩，沒有自行求出失穩點；實際分析還需剛度、端部條件及材料非線性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「第二階偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress. Local modifications can increase sensitivity of the entire support line. This expression gives added moment for a known deflection and does not solve instability; actual analysis also needs stiffness, end conditions and material nonlinearity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Second-order eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「第二階偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Second-order eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證
knowledge.text: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。支撐的穩定檢查因此不能只看平均軸應力，還要核對接頭對心、側向約束與實際彎曲方向；局部改動可使整個支撐線更敏感。
knowledge.textEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. Stability checks therefore require alignment, lateral restraint and actual bending direction as well as average axial stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 壓力只沿支撐軸線傳遞，所以量到側彎也可忽略。
受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。
壓力表讀值乘任何外徑面積都能得到精確支撐力。
optionsEn: Compression acts only axially, so observed lateral bow can be ignored.
Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it.
Gauge pressure times any external cylinder area gives exact strut force.
quiz.explanation: 受壓構件的初始彎曲與荷載偏心會產生彎矩，軸力作用在追加側移上又放大彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial bow and load eccentricity produce bending in a compression member, and axial force acting on additional lateral displacement amplifies it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 第二階偏心的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「第二階偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Second-order eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量支撐直線度與接頭錯位，將側移和軸力同時輸入第二階分析，檢查側向繫材有效性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure strut straightness and splice offset, input lateral displacement and force together into second-order analysis, and verify effective lateral ties.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 卸載是把力減少，所以不需要像加載一樣分析。
截面越大，整條支撐系統就一定按相同比例變硬。

optionsEn: Unloading reduces force, so it needs no analysis comparable to loading.
A larger member area makes the whole support system proportionally stiffer.
Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設P=1000 kN、初偏心e₀=0.02 m、追加側移Δ=0.01 m，M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For P=1000 kN, initial eccentricity e₀=0.02 m and additional deflection Δ=0.01 m, M=P(e₀+Δ)=30 kN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 用錯活塞面積或忽略回壓會錯估預壓，摩擦遲滯又可能使升載與降載呈不同力值。理想公式假設差壓已扣除回壓且忽略摩擦，不是張拉操作程序；現場施力與停留點必須依核定設備和臨時工程方案。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong piston area or ignored backpressure misstates preload, while friction hysteresis gives different forces during loading and unloading. The ideal equation assumes backpressure is already removed and neglects friction; it is not an operating procedure, and force application follows approved equipment and temporary-works plans. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「壁移速率」如何影響深開挖內支撐預壓的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall movement rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Preloading of deep-excavation struts”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖壁移除了累積量，變化速率及與支撐受力的相位也能協助診斷。位移持續加速可能代表支承尚未形成、土體潛變或地下水變化；短時間跳點則需先排除測量基準或儀器問題，不能把所有異常都歸因於地層失穩。兩點平均速率不能顯示期間加速或峰值，也不是通用停工值；需依資產敏感度與施工反應時間訂定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壁移速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cumulative wall movement, rate and timing relative to strut force all aid diagnosis. Sustained acceleration may indicate incomplete restraint, soil creep or groundwater changes, whereas a sudden isolated jump first requires checks of datum and instrument integrity. Not every anomalous reading establishes ground instability, but trends must not be dismissed without evidence. A two-point mean rate hides intermediate acceleration and peaks and is not a universal stop value; criteria depend on asset sensitivity and response time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall movement rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「累積位移仍低於警戒值，就不必注意位移速率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「壁移速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 壁移速率的機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壁移速率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall movement rate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設位移由5 mm增至8 mm，間隔Δt=6 h，平均速率v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For displacement increasing from 5 mm to 8 mm over Δt=6 h, mean rate v=(8−5)/6=0.5 mm/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對傾度計、獨立測量及開挖日誌，檢查讀值是否同向持續，並同步查看支撐力與外水頭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare inclinometers, independent survey and excavation logs for persistent directional movement while checking strut force and external head simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
